item.text: I’ll inspect the API’s structure, authentication/data flows, and existing tests first, then I’ll patch confirmed vulnerabilities and run focused verification. I’ll preserve unrelated working-tree changes.

The first shell launch was blocked by the environment’s sandbox bootstrap, before any repository command ran. I’m retrying with a non-login shell and smaller read-only checks so I can distinguish an execution issue from a repository issue.

I couldn’t inspect or modify the API because the workspace sandbox fails before every command with:

` sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted `

Even `/bin/pwd` is blocked, so this is an environment initialization issue rather than a repository error. No files were read or changed. Please restart/reinitialize the workspace session, then resend the request and I’ll perform the security audit, implement fixes, and run the tests.
